notes.title: Roguelike sequel Enter the Gungeon 2 surprise announced, and it has a huge twist
notes.notes:
There are few games I love more than Enter the Gungeon. It's easily the roguelike I return to the most, and while Hades 2, Dead Cells, and Slay the Spire have all carved out special places in my heart, it's the bullet-themed bonanza that I just can't shake. Color me surprised to learn that Enter the Gungeon 2 isn't just real, then, but it's also making a pretty big change to the pixel art stylings of the original game.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Bullet hell dungeon crawler Enter the Gungeon 2 announced with a new 3D style
notes.notes:
Dodge Roll and Devolver Digital announced Enter the Gungeon 2 today, teased during the Nintendo Switch 2 event and it's coming to Steam as well in 2026.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/bullet-hell-dungeon-crawler-enter-the-gungeon-2-announced-with-a-new-3d-style/

notes.title: Enter the Gungeon 2 coming to Steam in 2026
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Gg15MFGINWY;full][/previewyoutube]

Rejoice, Gungeoneers! Kaliber has heard your prayers! [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339840/Enter_the_Gungeon_2/]Enter the Gungeon 2[/url][/b] is in active development and [b]will be coming to Steam in 2026[/b]. You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339840/Enter_the_Gungeon_2/]wishlist it now[/url], even if you don’t own a PC.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339840/Enter_the_Gungeon_2/

Enter the Gungeon 2 is a reloaded, high-caliber sequel, enhanced with a new 3D art style, new weapons, new enemies, and expanded gameplay.

Battle through familiar and unknown areas of the ruined Gungeon, uncovering secrets and mastering powerful weapons while destroying legions of Gundead, previously confined to the 2D plane. Choose from an expanding roster of Gungeoneers, new and old, rescue marooned heroes, and grow stronger through powerful passive and active items, blessings, curses, and your mastery of a vast arsenal of weapons.

And seek to understand why you find yourself under assault in the Gungeon once again…

We’re thrilled to finally reveal Enter the Gungeon 2 – you’ve been asking for it for so long! But please note we’re still in the midst of development, so we can’t share too much just yet.

In the meantime, we’ve set up an [url=https://discord.gg/DodgeRoll]official Discord server for Dodge Roll[/url], and we’d love to hear your thoughts on the announcement. [url=https://discord.gg/DodgeRoll]Join[/url] to share your feedback, get updates directly from the team, enjoy giveaways, and hang out with other Gungeoneers.
